title: RBAC Test Matrix
description: Single source of truth for every authorization gate exercised by automated tests. Lives at tests/rbac/rbac-matrix.yaml. Drives Jest, pytest, and Playwright test parameterisation. Verified by scripts/validate-rbac-matrix.py.
$comment: Peers: audit-event.schema.json, realm-config-extras.schema.json, and the Python/TypeScript parity tests under tests/rbac/.

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1; bump-and-migrate if shape changes.

routes.description: Every protected gate exercised by tests. Each entry is exhaustively parameterised over all 6 personas.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the file. Used as the test name in Jest and pytest.

surface.description: Which trust boundary the gate lives on. 'mcp' covers all <agent>_mcp servers; the specific server is identified via the 'resource' field.

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) or the literal 'rpc' for non-HTTP transports such as MCP tools/call.

path.description: HTTP path or RPC method name. E.g. '/api/admin/users', 'tools/call argocd.list_apps'.

resource.description: Keycloak resource name; must exist in deploy/keycloak/realm-config.json. Cross-validated by scripts/validate-realm-config.py.

scope.description: Keycloak scope name; must exist on the named resource.

expectations.description: Required: one entry per persona. Validator fails if any persona is missing.

migration_status.description: If 'pending', the call site has not yet been migrated to requireRbacPermission. The Jest matrix-driver and pytest matrix-driver skip these rows while surfacing the route id. The matrix linter still requires every gated route to appear; this flag controls only runtime test execution. The current matrix is expected to contain no pending rows.

status.description: Expected HTTP status code (or status-equivalent for RPCs).

reason.description: Required when status >= 400. Asserted against the audit log entry for this decision.

skip_reason.description: If present, the test for this persona is skipped (with this string surfaced). Use sparingly; should be the exception.

allOf.description: If status indicates failure (>=400), reason is required.

frank_service_account.skip_reason: service-account is allow-listed for ArgoCD writes

routes.notes: frank's service-account membership in 'argocd_admins' role is configured by init-idp.sh.
